issues.description: The FVT6 error migration still imports std::fmt::Error in its VM reader/writer and specification modules while referring to the project-specific InvalidArgs and PageFault variants, so the enabled modules cannot resolve those error values.
issues.rationale: The selected first PR commit switches to official Result support but leaves an explicit std::fmt::Error import. That standard formatting error is not the project enum and has neither InvalidArgs nor PageFault. FVT6 lib.rs enables io and its module declares vmrw/specs/fallible. The next direct child removes the formatting Error imports, imports crate::error::Error in fallible/specs, and re-exports crate::error through common so vmrw resolves its variants. This is one error-type migration root, not a claim that the final no-findings snapshot is faulty.
issues.verification: source-only; historical Verus not executed. Official three-commit PR list, fixed parent-child diff, module declarations, imports and enum uses inspected.
